_comment: The nutrition flow: screens use genui's built-in components (Card, Column, Row, Text, ChoicePicker, TextField, Slider, DateTimeInput, Button) plus the custom IconBadge (lib/catalog/icon_badge/icon_badge.dart). A createSurface "theme" sets colors, fonts and text styles (lib/core/theme/surface_theme.dart). Inputs are bound to the surface's data model with {"path": ...}; each Button sends those values as its action context. A route is a screen file, or {"screen": "../shared/…json", "with": {…}} to reuse a shared screen (notes, summary) with this flow's values for its {{slots}}. Placeholders: "{{name}}" is a value from an earlier action; "{{a,b|rows}}" turns the values of a and b (lists or comma-separated text) into rows [{"item": ..., "amount": "1 serving"}]; "{{a|text}}" turns any value into readable text (use it when a placeholder is a whole Text value); "{{a|lower}}" the same in lowercase.

with.notesHint: e.g. Ate at the office canteen, a bit spicier than usual
